ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, it is known that the radius of $\odot O$ is 2, points A and B are on $\odot O$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, and $\tan\angle ACB=2$. What is the maximum value of line segment OC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect OA, OB, and draw AD$\perp$AO such that $\angle ADO=\angle ABC$,\\
$\because$ in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, $\tan \angle ACB=2$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{AB}{AC}=2$, i.e., $AB=2AC$,\\
$\because$ $\angle ADO=\angle ABC$, $\angle OAD=\angle CAB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle ADO\sim \triangle ABC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{AO}{AC}=\frac{AD}{AB}$, $\angle AOD=\angle ACB$,\\
$\because$ $\angle DAO=\angle BAC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DAB=\angle OAC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle DAB\sim \triangle OAC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{BD}{OC}=\frac{AB}{AC}=2$,\\
$\therefore$ $OC=\frac{1}{2}BD$,\\
In $\triangle AOD$, $\tan \angle AOD=\tan \angle ACB=\frac{AD}{OA}=2$,\\
$\therefore$ $AD=2AO=4$,\\
$\therefore$ $OD=\sqrt{OA^2+AD^2}=2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\because$ $BD\le OD+OB=2+2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ the maximum value of BD is $2+2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ the maximum value of OC is $\boxed{1+\sqrt{5}}$.

先描述图像：图中有一个以 O 为圆心的圆，A、B 两点在圆周左侧，线段 AB、AC、BC 构成三角形 ABC，另有线段 OC 从圆心 O 连到点 C；图中 C 位于 AB 的右侧并靠近圆心附近。
再推理：设 O 为原点，圆半径为 2。旋转坐标系令 A=(2,0)。设 B=(2cosθ, 2sinθ)。因为 ∠BAC=90°，所以 AC ⟂ AB；又 tan∠ACB=2，在直角三角形 ABC 中 tan∠ACB=AB/AC，所以 AB/AC=2，即 AC=AB/2。因此向量 AC 可以表示为向量 AB 的 90°旋转后的一半：C=A ± (1/2)R90(B-A)。
令 R90(x,y)=(-y,x)。则 |OC|²=|C|²=|A|²+(1/4)|B-A|² ± A·R90(B-A)。这里 |A|²=4，|B-A|²=(2cosθ-2)²+(2sinθ)²=8(1-cosθ)，所以前两项为 4+2(1-cosθ)=6-2cosθ。又 A·R90(B-A) 可通过选取有利符号变成 +4sinθ，因此 OC²=6-2cosθ+4sinθ。
最大化 -2cosθ+4sinθ，其最大值为 sqrt((-2)²+4²)=2√5。所以 OC² 的最大值为 6+2√5。因为 6+2√5=(1+√5)²，所以 OC 的最大值为 1+√5。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the diagram, it is known that the radius of $\odot O$ is 2, points A and B are on $\odot O$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, and $\tan\angle ACB=2$. What is the maximum value of line segment OC?
raw_record.answer: \textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect OA, OB, and draw AD$\perp$AO such that $\angle ADO=\angle ABC$, because in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, $\tan \angle ACB=2$, therefore $\frac{AB}{AC}=2$, i.e., $AB=2AC$, because $\angle ADO=\angle ABC$, $\angle OAD=\angle CAB=90^\circ$, therefore $\triangle ADO\sim \triangle ABC$, therefore $\frac{AO}{AC}=\frac{AD}{AB}$, $\angle AOD=\angle ACB$, because $\angle DAO=\angle BAC$, therefore $\angle DAB=\angle OAC$, therefore $\triangle DAB\sim \triangle OAC$, therefore $\frac{BD}{OC}=\frac{AB}{AC}=2$, therefore $OC=\frac{1}{2}BD$, In $\triangle AOD$, $\tan \angle AOD=\tan \angle ACB=\frac{AD}{OA}=2$, therefore $AD=2AO=4$, therefore $OD=\sqrt{OA^2+AD^2}=2\sqrt{5}$, because $BD\le OD+OB=2+2\sqrt{5}$, therefore the maximum value of BD is $2+2\sqrt{5}$, therefore the maximum value of OC is $\boxed{1+\sqrt{5}}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle, with the center of the circle labeled O; points A and B are on the circle, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left; C is inside the circle, toward the upper right, and line segments AB, AC, and BC form triangle ABC; OC is also drawn in the figure. The problem gives that circle O has radius 2, therefore OA=OB=2, and gives ∠BAC=90°, tan∠ACB=2.

Then reason: In right triangle ABC, ∠BAC=90°, so tan∠ACB=AB/AC=2, that is, AB/AC=2. Connect OA and OB. Construct auxiliary point D, such that AD⊥AO, and ∠ADO=∠ABC. Because ∠OAD=90°=∠BAC, and ∠ADO=∠ABC, △ADO∼△ABC, hence ∠AOD=∠ACB, and AD/OA=AB/AC=2. Also OA=2, so AD=4. Thus in right triangle AOD, OD=sqrt(OA^2+AD^2)=sqrt(2^2+4^2)=2sqrt(5).

Since ∠DAO=∠BAC=90°, it can be obtained that ∠DAB=∠OAC; and AD/OA=AB/AC=2, so △DAB∼△OAC. Therefore BD/OC=AB/AC=2, that is, OC=BD/2.

Now it is only necessary to maximize BD. Because OB=2, OD=2sqrt(5), in triangle BOD, by the triangle inequality there is BD≤BO+OD=2+2sqrt(5). When B, O, and D are collinear and O is located between B and D, equality can be attained. So the maximum value of BD is 2+2sqrt(5), and thus the maximum value of OC is (2+2sqrt(5))/2=1+sqrt(5).
